method.physical_time: frame_index*0.02+substep*0.005 denotes interval start; forces averaged over 5ms interval
method.airborne_detection: longest contiguous interval in [1.0,1.9) with all four recorded contact body force norms < threshold; evaluated separately at 1,5,10N; no hardware or policy acceptance threshold
method.contact_scope: right/left feet and wheels only; no other-body contact claim
method.body_position_error_semantics: reference aligned to actual anchor XY and yaw, retains reference anchor Z; anchor_position_rmse measures unaligned global anchor displacement
method.phase_metrics: all collected samples including unfinished tail; airborne episode summary includes full frame-zero completed episodes only
method.torque: PD computed/applied drive torque, excludes passive collision load
method.force: simulator normal net contact force excluding friction, averaged over each physics step
method.statistical_scope: single environment, seed42; randomized startup mass/friction/COM realization fixed per process, reset pose/vel/gains/noise/delay vary; repeated nominal cycles are deterministic
